create_gemini_client: create a GeminiNativeClient instance with an API key to call Gemini's native REST API
build_gemini_request: build a Gemini API request dict from OpenAI-style messages, tools, and generation config parameters
translate_gemini_response: translate a Gemini API response dict into an OpenAI-compatible chat completion object
test_is_native_gemini_url: test whether a base URL points to Gemini's native REST API instead of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
summarize_gemini_stream: summarize a streaming Gemini response by iterating SSE events and converting each chunk to OpenAI-compatible stream chunks
